ctaHeading: Need Auto Repair in Kensington? We're Here to Help.
aboutText: At Wishart Auto Tech in Kensington, we are committed to providing the best possible service to our customers. With years of experience in car repair, we offer a range of options to suit every need and budget. From genuine original equipment from top brands like Denso and Valeo to cost-effective aftermarket solutions, we ensure your vehicle receives the care it deserves. Our specialisation in aluminium and plastic welding sets us apart for affordable and reliable repairs.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of car repair services tailored to your vehicle's needs. From routine servicing to specialised welding repairs, our skilled technicians ensure high-quality workmanship using both genuine and aftermarket parts.
